_comment: P3 plain-phrase library. watching keyed by signal id — used for the two nearest-to-flip signals that fill the {watching} slot of the monthly standing read. Jargon-free per C3 (no EMA/RSI/SMA). (The old change-driver phrases were retired when the plain layer moved to weekly-opener + transition-agnostic standing, 2026-07-28.)

watching._comment: PENDING_ALL 5.192, founder-ruled option (a), authorised 2026-09-15. Keyed by (signal x STATE), like signal-sentences.json. It was keyed by id ALONE, while generate.mjs#watchingIds() picks the two signals nearest a flip REGARDLESS of state — so a phrase written for one state was emitted in the other. Ten of the eleven presupposed a state; on 2026-09-15 production read 'nearly all of what we track is aligned toward the price. What we're watching: whether the price can climb back above its long middle line' with BTC-01 ACTIVE and already above that line. ACTIVE phrases watch a supportive condition PERSISTING; INACTIVE phrases watch it TURNING. Both states are required for every signal.
